deadlines.label: SFU Fall 2027 application deadline (high school applicants)
deadlines.notes: Apply on Education Planner BC; applications open 1 Oct 2026. Admission documents are due 28 Feb 2027. Beedie School of Business applicants must complete their to-do list by 7 Feb 2027 (not relevant to the programs listed). Early admission consideration is only for B.C. 12 curriculum students.

english_policy.waiver_notes: All applicants, regardless of country of origin or citizenship, must show English competence in listening, reading, speaking and writing. Without a test this can be done with the last three years of full-time secondary education in English in Canada or in an English-principal country, or the last four years at a recognized English-medium international school elsewhere (each with 70% in a senior English course), an IB Diploma including English A (HL/SL) grade 3, a three-unit transferable English or writing course (C-), or GCSE O-Level English grade 4 (C). Language proficiency exam scores older than 24 months are not considered.

english.notes: IELTS Academic; IELTS One Skill Retake results are not accepted.
1-120 scale, for tests taken before 21 Jan 2026. Single sitting; MyBest and TOEFL Essentials not used; TOEFL iBT Home accepted.
1-6 scale, for tests from 21 Jan 2026. Single sitting; MyBest and TOEFL Essentials not used; TOEFL iBT Home accepted.
Duolingo English Test, overall score of 125; no sub-score minimum listed.
Overall 65 and at least 60 in each Communicative Skill (Listening, Reading, Speaking, Writing).
B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency; overall 176 with no part less than 169.

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 312, 13th of the Canadian universities in the table (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
